scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run backend:dev" "npm run frontend:dev"
scripts.dev:no-infra: node scripts/ensure-deps.js && concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run backend:dev" "npm run frontend:dev"
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres && node scripts/wait-db.js
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres && node scripts/wait-db.js
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run backend:install && npm run frontend:install
scripts.build:all: npm run backend:build && npm run frontend:build
scripts.db:reset: npm run infra:reset && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run infra:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.clean: rm -rf backend/dist backend/node_modules frontend/dist frontend/node_modules node_modules
